messages:
lee-cs: Heads up — Bambui Finance is prepping a live demo on 2025-06-05 and asked for a temporary burst + CIDR allowlist for their Brazil office, plus a one-time API key rotation. Can we provision 300 QPS (currently 50) for 72h starting 2025-06-05T14:00:00Z? CIDRs: `200.34.12.0/24`, `200.34.13.0/24`. /cc @sam-eng @jonathan-netops

sam-eng: Quick clarifying q: is this Hosted or Dedicated? Any mTLS/client cert requirements?

lee-cs: Hosted. No mTLS required — just CIDR allowlist + short-lived rate bump. They specifically want an ephemeral API key scoped to the demo and auto-revoked after 4 days.

jonathan-netops: I can add the CIDRs to the Brazil edge peering ACLs. Need exact ISO start/end — can you confirm UTC windows? Also will route to `sa-east-1` only during the window?

lee-cs: Confirmed. Start `2025-06-05T14:00:00Z` end `2025-06-08T14:00:00Z`. Route traffic to `sa-east-1` for the duration.

jonathan-netops: Opening infra ticket now. Plan snippet:
```
- add ACL entries 200.34.12.0/24, 200.34.13.0/24 to br-edge-peers
- create rate-cap override for customer:bambui -> 300 QPS window 72h
- tag ephemeral API key set: bambui-demo-20250605
- schedule apply at 2025-06-05T13:50:00Z for smoke tests
```
I'll apply and post smoke logs.

marie-cs: I'll distribute the ephemeral key to their SRE via secure share and include the demo runbook + contact info. I'll also capture enablement feedback after the demo. @opsteam-bot can you schedule a revoke reminder at `2025-06-08T14:05:00Z`?

opsteam-bot: Reminder created: `revoke-keys-bambui-20250608` at 2025-06-08T14:05:00Z :white_check_mark:

sam-eng: Please drop the infra ticket link and any expected tail-latency or perf notes here so CS can set expectations.

jonathan-netops: infra-12345 -> https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/12345. Expect negligible tail-latency impact (<5ms) at the edge; no model swaps or quant changes. Will paste smoke output after rollout.

lee-cs: Perfect — thanks team :thumbsup: moving ahead on scheduling and customer comms.
